name: maestro-e2e
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project maestro-e2e --web

e2e.command: node tools/dev-instance/cli.mjs run-workflow electron-e2e -- nx run maestro-electron:build -c development --then playwright test -c apps/maestro-e2e/playwright.electron.config.ts

e2e-renderer.command: node tools/dev-instance/cli.mjs run-workflow renderer-e2e -- playwright test -c apps/maestro-e2e/playwright.renderer.config.ts
